enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to side. Pull blanket. Remain still. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and morning hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe mouth with towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out eggs. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Close cupboard. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs in bowl. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up. Place bowl in sink. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Apply deodorant. Pick up bag. Pick up keys. Pick up phone. Pick up wallet. Walk out of bedroom.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Read messages. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a community program coordinator at a nonprofit
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Check emails. Reply to emails. Answer phone. Talk on phone. Attend meeting. Take notes. Write report. Print document. File papers. Make phone calls. Organize files. Attend another meeting. Write schedule. Talk to colleague. Use computer.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Read news. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out pot. Close cupboard. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Add vegetables. Add meat. Stir. Turn off stove. Serve food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Place plate in sink.

Enter living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Walk back. Sit down. Watch TV.

Enter bedroom. Sit at desk. Open computer. Turn on computer. Log in. Open browser. Browse internet. Open email. Reply to email. Open social media. Scroll through feed. Watch video. Play game. Type document. Save document. Close computer. Stand up. Stretch. Walk to bathroom.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off light. Walk out.
Enter bedroom. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read pages. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to side. Pull blanket. Remain still. Sleep.
